d: Ramlal ke parivar men tivi ki zid ek dilchasp bahas ko janm deti hai. bachchon aur patni ke dabav men aakhirkar ghar men tivi aa jata hai, lekin dhire-dhire manoranjan ki yah duniya parhaee, khelkud aur parivarik samay par havi hone lagti hai. tab parivar ko ehsas hota hai ki tivi bura nahin, balki uska bina soche-samjhe istemal nuksandeh hai. yah natak hansi-mazak ke sath manoranjan aur jivan men santulan ka sandesh deta hai.
